scaleme.midnightconfig.title: ScaleMe
scaleme.midnightconfig.handDesc: How the item in your hand is drawn in first person. The three sections below are independent — turn ones you want. Options stay hidden until the section they belong to is on.
scaleme.midnightconfig.armPosDesc: §lHand Position§r — where your hand sits on screen
scaleme.midnightconfig.enableArmPosition:
Moves the whole hand — arm and item together — to a new spot on screen.

Use this first for big changes. Item Size & Angle then fine-tunes the item on top of wherever the hand ends up.
scaleme.midnightconfig.armBaseX.tooltip:
How far to the side your hand sits.
Vanilla: 0.56 · Lower moves it toward the centre of the screen.
scaleme.midnightconfig.armBaseY.tooltip:
How high your hand sits.
Vanilla: -0.52 · Higher raises the hand into view.
scaleme.midnightconfig.armBaseZ.tooltip:
How far in front of you your hand sits.
Vanilla: -0.72 · Lower pushes it further away.
scaleme.midnightconfig.armHeightScale.to:
How far the hand dips down while an item is being raised or swapped.
Vanilla: -0.6 · Set to 0 to hold the item perfectly still during the equip animation.
scaleme.midnightconfig.itemTransformDesc: §lItem Size & Angle§r — adjusts the item only, not the arm
scaleme.midnightconfig.enableItemTransfo:
Resizes, nudges and rotates the item in your hand.

Applied on top of Hand Position, so both can be used together. The arm itself is not affected.
scaleme.midnightconfig.itemScale.tooltip: How big the item appears. 1.0 is normal size.
Nudges the item sideways. 0 leaves it where the hand puts it.
Nudges the item up or down. 0 leaves it where the hand puts it.
Nudges the item toward or away from the camera. 0 leaves it where the hand puts it.
scaleme.midnightconfig.itemRotationX.too: Tips the item forward or back, like nodding.
scaleme.midnightconfig.itemRotationY.too: Turns the item to face left or right.
scaleme.midnightconfig.itemRotationZ.too: Rolls the item clockwise or counterclockwise.
scaleme.midnightconfig.offhandDesc: §lOff-Hand§r — by default the off-hand mirrors everything above
scaleme.midnightconfig.enableSeparateHan: Give the Off-Hand Its Own Settings

Lets the off-hand use different values from the main hand.

When off, the off-hand simply copies the main hand.
Each off-hand option below appears only once the matching main-hand section is also on.
scaleme.midnightconfig.armBaseXOffhand.t:
Off-hand version of Hand Position — Left / Right.
Vanilla: 0.56
scaleme.midnightconfig.armBaseYOffhand.t:
Off-hand version of Hand Position — Up / Down.
Vanilla: -0.52
scaleme.midnightconfig.armBaseZOffhand.t:
Off-hand version of Hand Position — Near / Far.
Vanilla: -0.72
scaleme.midnightconfig.armHeightScaleOff:
Off-hand version of Equip Dip Amount.
Vanilla: -0.6
Off-hand version of Item Size. 1.0 is normal size.
scaleme.midnightconfig.itemTranslationXO: Off-hand version of Item Offset — Left / Right.
scaleme.midnightconfig.itemTranslationYO: Off-hand version of Item Offset — Up / Down.
scaleme.midnightconfig.itemTranslationZO: Off-hand version of Item Offset — Near / Far.
scaleme.midnightconfig.animDesc: How your arm behaves when you attack or use an item.
Hold right-click with a sword to enter a blocking pose, like pre-1.9.

This is a visual pose only. The keybind defaults to right mouse button and can be changed under Controls.
scaleme.midnightconfig.disableSwingAnima:
Your arm stays completely still when you click.

This replaces every other option in this category, so the rest are hidden while it is on.
scaleme.midnightconfig.suppressRepeatedS: Hide Repeated Swings While Holding Attack

Shows the first swing when you hold Attack, then stops later swings until you release the button.

This changes the visual animation only — attacking and mining continue normally.
scaleme.midnightconfig.holdRepeatedSwing:
Keeps your arm in its deepest downward chop after the first swing finishes.

Turn this off to let the arm return to its normal resting position instead.
scaleme.midnightconfig.swingAnimationSpe:
How quickly the swing plays. 1.0 is normal speed, higher is faster.

This changes the animation only — it does not affect how fast you can actually attack or mine.
scaleme.midnightconfig.ignoreSwingSpeedE:
Haste and Mining Fatigue no longer speed up or slow down the animation.

On: the swing always runs at the Swing Speed set above.
Off: Swing Speed multiplies whatever speed those effects would give you.
scaleme.midnightconfig.disableSwingBobbi:
Holds the item steady instead of letting it bounce with your attack cooldown.

While on, this takes priority over the Equip Dip Amount setting in Held Item.
scaleme.midnightconfig.swingShapeDesc: §lSwing Shape§r — the path the item travels
scaleme.midnightconfig.enableSwingOverri:
Replaces the vanilla swing arc with your own.

Leave off to keep the normal swing shape while still using the speed and bouncing options above. Every slider below lists its vanilla value, so you can rebuild the default at any time.
scaleme.midnightconfig.swingArcXAmount.t:
The main downward motion of the swing.
Vanilla: -80° · Closer to 0 gives a flatter, shorter swing.
scaleme.midnightconfig.swingArcYAmount.t:
How far the item sweeps across during the swing.
Vanilla: -20° · Negative sweeps left, positive sweeps right.
scaleme.midnightconfig.swingArcZAmount.t:
How much the item leans over as it swings.
Vanilla: -20°
scaleme.midnightconfig.swingPreRotationY:
The angle the item is turned to before the swing starts.
Vanilla: 45° · Lower keeps the item facing you more directly.
scaleme.midnightconfig.swingCounterRotat:
Swings the item back toward the middle of the screen as the motion finishes. This is normal Minecraft behaviour.

Turn off to hold the resting angle throughout, closer to how 1.8 looked.
scaleme.midnightconfig.swingArmXScale.to:
How far the item drifts sideways mid-swing.
Vanilla: -0.4 · Set to 0 to remove the sideways drift.
scaleme.midnightconfig.swingArmYScale.to:
How far the item drifts up and down mid-swing.
Vanilla: 0.2 · Set to 0 to remove the vertical drift.
scaleme.midnightconfig.swingArmZScale.to:
How far the item thrusts toward the screen mid-swing.
Vanilla: -0.2 · Set to 0 to remove the forward thrust.
scaleme.midnightconfig.swingArmXMultiply:
Flips the sideways lunge for the off-hand so both hands mirror each other. This is normal Minecraft behaviour.

Turn off to make both hands drift the same direction.
scaleme.midnightconfig.scaleDesc: Sizes of players, NPCs and dropped items. Every slider here is independent — 1.0 means off, so nothing changes until you move one.
scaleme.midnightconfig.playerScale.toolt:
How big your own character appears. 1.0 = off.

Only changes what you see — other players still see you at normal size, and your first-person view is unaffected.
scaleme.midnightconfig.otherPlayersScale:
How big other players appear to you. 1.0 = off.

On Hypixel this applies on SkyBlock only, so it can never give an advantage in PvP or minigames.
scaleme.midnightconfig.hypixelNpcScale.t:
How big Hypixel NPCs appear. 1.0 = off.

Only works on Hypixel, and is always left at normal size inside Dungeons.
scaleme.midnightconfig.scaleNameTags.too:
Name tags grow and shrink along with the entity instead of staying a fixed size.

Only matters when one of the size sliders above is in use.
scaleme.midnightconfig.groundItemScale.t: How big items lying on the ground appear. 1.0 = off.
scaleme.midnightconfig.viewDescription: Crosshair visibility and third-person camera behaviour.
scaleme.midnightconfig.enableCrosshairIn: Keeps the crosshair visible when the camera is behind you.
Keeps the crosshair visible when the camera faces you from the front.
Removes the front-facing camera from the F5 rotation, so it cycles straight from behind-the-back back to first person.
scaleme.midnightconfig.showOwnNametagInT: Displays your own name above your head while in third person.
scaleme.midnightconfig.hidePlayers.toolt:
Stops other players from being drawn. Useful in crowded areas.

You are never hidden from yourself.
scaleme.midnightconfig.hidePlayersOnlyOn: Limits hiding to Hypixel SkyBlock. Everywhere else, other players stay visible.
